summary: A feature article follows a year of intramural sports at College State University, from the September 2023 soccer kickoff to the May basketball finals. Through quotes from student athletes in soccer, football, volleyball, badminton, track and field, and basketball, it argues that intramurals build friendship, teamwork, mental toughness, self-improvement and unity across diverse students.
one_line: A year of intramural sports at College State University, told through student athletes, shows how play builds friendship, teamwork, resilience and personal growth.
key_facts: The intramural soccer season at College State University opened on September 15th, 2023, with senior Jamie Ellis kicking the ceremonial first ball.
Jamie Ellis said intramurals are about "building friendships, learning how to trust in others, and trusting in yourself."
On the evening of October 5th, College State University's intramural football teams played on the university's recreational field before cheering crowds.
Sophomore Mike Johnson, who said he wasn't much of an athlete in high school, described his football teammates as "my brothers."
A pivotal volleyball match took place on November 12th, and Andrea Thompson, captain of the 'Spike Masters,' spoke about teamwork in small moments like a shared glance before a serve.
Badminton matches were held on the evening of December 3rd, where first-year student Liam Andrews described an underdog victory and the value of being mentally tough and pushing through.
The track and field portion took place on the evening of April 9th, when junior Rachel Kim shaved seconds off her personal best.
Rachel Kim said, "the biggest competition is the one you have with yourself."
The basketball finals were held on May 21st and featured students from every corner of campus, representing unity in diversity.
Senior Ayesha Patel said that when students play, differences in stories and backgrounds don't matter; they just want to win and "lift each other up."
The article concludes that local colleges are arenas where life lessons are embraced and character is built, shaping the leaders of tomorrow.
